raw_segments.text: Abbess, and thereof came it that the man was mad.
The venom clamors of a jealous woman poisons more deadly than a mad dog's tooth.
It seems his sleeps were hindered by thy railing, and thereof comes it that his head is light.
Thou say'st he his meat was socked with thy upbraidings.
Unquiet meals make ill-digestions, thereof the raging fire of fever bread, and what's
a fever but a fit of madness.
Thou say'st he his sports were hindered by thy brawls.
Sweet recreation bard, what doth ensue but moody and dull melancholy, kinsmen to grim
and comfortless despair, and at her heels a huge infectious troop of pale distemperatures
and foes to life, in food, in sport, and life-preserving rest to be disturbed would mad or man or beast.
The consequence is, then, thy jealous fits hath scarred thy husband from the use of zwits.
